---
title: "Fact-checking simulation analysis"
output: html_notebook
---

## Load the batch files

Set `results_dir` to the folder containing the two CSVs from `batch_run.py`.

```{r load-data}
results_dir <- "results"
runs_file <- file.path(results_dir, "runs.csv")
trajectories_file <- file.path(results_dir, "trajectories.csv")

if (!file.exists(runs_file) || !file.exists(trajectories_file)) {
  stop("Generate the batch CSVs with batch_run.py before running this chunk.")
}

runs <- read.csv(
  runs_file,
  colClasses = c(run_seed = "character", threshold_reached = "character")
)
trajectories <- read.csv(trajectories_file, colClasses = c(run_seed = "character"))

head(runs)
head(trajectories)
```

## Prepare the data

```{r prepare-data}
if (anyDuplicated(runs$run_seed) ||
    !setequal(runs$run_seed, trajectories$run_seed)) {
  stop("The CSVs must describe the same runs, with one summary per run.")
}

step_count <- unique(runs$steps)
threshold <- unique(runs$threshold)
if (length(step_count) != 1L || length(threshold) != 1L) {
  stop("Expected one observation window and one threshold.")
}

steps <- seq.int(0L, step_count)
steps_by_run <- split(trajectories$step, trajectories$run_seed)
complete_runs <- vapply(
  steps_by_run,
  function(run_steps) identical(sort(run_steps, na.last = TRUE), steps),
  logical(1)
)
if (!all(complete_runs) || anyNA(trajectories$prevalence)) {
  stop("Each run must have one prevalence value per step.")
}

threshold_status <- tolower(runs$threshold_reached)
if (any(!threshold_status %in% c("true", "false"))) {
  stop("threshold_reached must be true or false for every run.")
}
runs$threshold_reached <- threshold_status == "true"

fact_check_steps <- sort(unique(runs$fact_check_step))
peer_influence_levels <- sort(unique(runs$peer_influence))
if (length(fact_check_steps) != 2L || length(peer_influence_levels) != 2L ||
    any(table(runs$fact_check_step, runs$peer_influence) == 0)) {
  stop("Expected runs in all four combinations of timing and peer influence.")
}

runs$timing <- factor(
  runs$fact_check_step,
  levels = fact_check_steps,
  labels = paste("Fact-check at step", fact_check_steps)
)
runs$influence <- factor(
  runs$peer_influence,
  levels = peer_influence_levels,
  labels = sprintf("Peer influence %.2f", peer_influence_levels)
)
plot_data <- merge(
  trajectories, runs[c("run_seed", "timing", "influence")], by = "run_seed"
)
mean_trajectory <- aggregate(
  prevalence ~ step + timing + influence, data = plot_data, FUN = mean
)
fact_checks <- unique(runs[c("timing", "fact_check_step")])
```

## Summarize the conditions

```{r summarize-conditions}
conditions <- split(runs, list(runs$influence, runs$timing))
condition_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(conditions, function(group) {
  data.frame(
    fact_check_step = group$fact_check_step[1],
    peer_influence = group$peer_influence[1],
    runs = nrow(group),
    peak_prevalence_mean = mean(group$peak_prevalence),
    peak_prevalence_sd = sd(group$peak_prevalence),
    final_prevalence_mean = mean(group$final_prevalence),
    final_prevalence_sd = sd(group$final_prevalence),
    threshold = threshold,
    threshold_reached = sum(group$threshold_reached),
    threshold_not_reached = sum(!group$threshold_reached)
  )
}))
rownames(condition_summary) <- NULL
condition_summary
```

## Plot the prevalence trajectories

```{r plot-trajectories, fig.width=10, fig.height=7}
library(ggplot2)

prevalence_plot <- ggplot() +
  geom_line(
    data = plot_data,
    aes(step, prevalence, group = run_seed, color = "Individual run"),
    alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.35
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    data = fact_checks,
    aes(xintercept = fact_check_step, color = "Fact-check step"),
    linetype = "dashed"
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = mean_trajectory,
    aes(step, prevalence, color = "Mean prevalence"),
    linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  facet_grid(timing ~ influence) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, step_count)) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 1),
    breaks = seq(0, 1, by = 0.25),
    labels = function(values) paste0(100 * values, "%")
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "Individual run" = "#8495A3",
      "Mean prevalence" = "#15548B",
      "Fact-check step" = "#AE501A"
    ),
    breaks = c("Individual run", "Mean prevalence", "Fact-check step")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Time step", y = "Agents who believe the claim", color = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

prevalence_plot
```

## Export the figure and table

```{r export-results, eval=FALSE}
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "prevalence-by-condition.pdf"),
  prevalence_plot, width = 10, height = 7
)
write.csv(
  condition_summary, file.path(results_dir, "condition-summary.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE, na = ""
)
```
